categories.main_business_segments: Ningbo Joy Intelligent Logistics Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in providing recyclable packaging integrated solutions, including product design, manufacturing, testing, leasing, logistics, and warehousing services. Its main business segments cover recyclable packaging products and leasing & operation services, serving industries such as automotive manufacturing, home appliances, fresh produce, express logistics, and others.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies including high-impact modified polypropylene materials, thick-wall thermoforming, injection molding, and composite materials like carbon fiber reinforced honeycomb panels. It integrates IoT technologies such as RFID for smart packaging and warehouse management. Production methods include customized design, mold development, automated manufacturing, and quality control aligned with international standards like VDA and ISTA.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major automotive manufacturers and first-tier suppliers such as Volkswagen, Tesla, BYD, BMW, Volvo, and others, as well as home appliance companies like Midea and Haier. The company also serves fresh produce, express logistics, and retail sectors including JD.com and Hema Fresh. The primary markets are automotive manufacturing, home appliances, logistics, fresh produce, and beverage industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates within China, with 99.29% of revenue generated domestically and a small but growing portion from overseas markets (0.71%). It has subsidiaries and joint ventures in cities including Ningbo, Shanghai, Chongqing, and Hefei, and exports products to Europe, Southeast Asia, and other regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ningbo Joy Intelligent Logistics Technology operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on packaging solution design, manufacturing, leasing, and logistics services. It acts as a packaging supplier and service provider integrated into customers' logistics and production processes, supporting closed-loop and circular packaging systems.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in recyclable packaging materials and structures, focusing on lightweight, high-strength, flame-retardant, and automated assembly-compatible designs. Key projects include battery module packaging, environmentally friendly cushioning materials, PCBA protective packaging, and smart packaging with RFID integration. It aims to enhance product performance, environmental compliance, and automation compatibility to support emerging industries like new energy vehicles and energy storage.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through direct sales of recyclable packaging products and leasing & operation services. Leasing services include dynamic rental based on usage frequency and static rental based on rental days. The company also earns income from value-added services such as warehousing, cleaning, logistics, and packaging recovery.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in China's recyclable packaging sector, recognized for its comprehensive packaging solutions and strong customer relationships with top automotive and home appliance brands. It holds competitive advantages in technology innovation, product quality, and integrated service models. While specific competitors are not named, the company positions itself as a market leader in recyclable packaging and supply chain services.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total operating revenue of approximately RMB 366.3 million, a 9.14% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 11.8 million. Despite short-term profitability challenges due to market competition and increased fixed costs, the company maintains a total asset base of RMB 1.32 billion and continues investing in R&D and production capacity expansion. Cash flow from operations improved significantly, indicating operational cash strength.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes customized, high-performance recyclable packaging solutions that reduce costs and environmental impact for customers. Its products feature high durability, lightweight design, multi-functionality, and compliance with stringent automotive and environmental standards. The integrated leasing and logistics services lower customers' packaging usage barriers and optimize supply chain efficiency, creating strong customer loyalty and competitive differentiation.
